title: Krispy Papi ERP System
description: Papiverse is a secure back-office management platform for Krispy Papi. It centralizes branch operations, inventory and supply orders, raw-material tracking, expenses, payments, commissions, settlements, and sales reporting. With role-based access, transaction logs, approval workflows, and real-time updates.

title: CvSU Alumni Connect: A Web-Based Alumni Tracer and Engagement System
description: A centralized alumni tracer and engagement platform that helps Cavite State University maintain graduate records, administer adaptive questionnaires, analyze outcomes, prepare institutional reports, and keep alumni connected through university events.

title: Papiverse: Franchise Management System for Krispy Papi
description: A franchise management system designed for Krispy Papi to monitor sales, inventory, supply orders, and branch performance across multiple franchise locations.

title: CvSU Faculty Connect: An Information Management System for CvSU Faculty
description: A commissioned capstone project that provides CvSU faculty with a centralized platform for announcements, events, personnel, accomplishments, financial records, and real-time communication.

title: PESO Mendez Employment Website
description: A web-based employment portal developed for PESO Mendez to connect job seekers and employers through job postings, applications, and applicant management.

title: PESO Mendez Employment Mobile App
description: A mobile application employment portal developed for PESO Mendez to connect job seekers and employers through job postings, applications, and applicant management.

title: DigiCog: Gaming Storefront and Community Hub
description: A full-stack gaming platform that combines game discovery and purchasing workflows with profiles, community posts, friendships, and private messaging in one responsive experience.

title: Braille Calculator
description: A frontend prototype showcasing the design of a hardware calculator with braille markings and voice assistance for visually impaired users.

title: ELITS Website: WEBFEST Winning Entry
description: A winning WEBFEST competition entry created as a static website for the ELITS student organization at CvSU Main Campus.

title: Calzada: An Ecommerce Website
description: An ecommerce website that showcase products and simulate adding to cart and purchasing order just like in any online shop websites.

title: Tkinter Baking System
description: A desktop-based ATM simulation built with Tkinter that allows deposit, withdraw, and check account balances through a GUI.
